reviews.title: 108 SPAM CALLS & TEXTS IN 2 DAYS — ROBOKILLER ISN’T WORKING!
reviews.text:
This used to be such a great app, but unfortunately it has become absolutely terrible. The spam filtering simply is NOT working anymore.

Yesterday alone, I received 64 spam calls and texts in a single day. Today, I received another 44. That is completely unacceptable for an app I’m paying for specifically to stop this problem.

I block the numbers. I report them. I follow the recommended steps. Nothing works. My phone number is also registered on the “National Do Not Call Registry”, yet the volume of spam getting through RoboKiller has become unbelievable.

What is the point of paying for a spam blocking app when I’m receiving more than 100 spam calls and texts in 2 days?

RoboKiller used to work extremely well, which is why this is so disappointing. Something has clearly changed. Please fix the filtering technology and get this app back to what it used to be.

reviews.title: 200% Increase on Subscription Price with no new features
reviews.text: Robokiller was both a necessity and novel when it first came out. Some of the features seemed fun at the time, like funny prerecorded greetings. But its utility has become increasingly unnecessary. There are no-call lists now and carriers like Verizon and AT&T have their own apps now that perform the same function. And without offering any new features the subscription price of Robokiller has just skyrocketed from $5.99/mo to $10.99/mo. It seems that any app bought out by Bending Spoons is turned into a cash grab. Look into alternatives.

reviews.title: Not Worth the Money
reviews.text:
I signed up for the trial and was subscribed to the service for a few months. 

The app addressed spam calls by having a bot answer the call which is good because it prevents spam callers from leaving messages and it prevents you from having a ton of missed call notifications from spam callers. However, the incoming call notification still pops up on your screen which is annoying. 

Overall, the app is not worth the money. 

My initial subscription price was 7.99 per week. Emphasis on per week! Then they increased to $9.99 per week. That would be $519 a year which is absurd! 

I personally find the weekly subscription to be a marketing ploy to make the service look more affordable than it actually is. Paying $9.99/week ($519/year) to still have notifications related to spam calls showing up on your phone is crazy.  I do not recommend this app. In stead use the free spam calls silencing that comes built in to iPhones.
